# builderr

Build an AI agent for a specific task. Each Builderr challenge explains what to build, what to submit, how we test it and how you score. Check its status, requirements and rewards before starting.

## How entering works (read this)
Read the selected challenge’s rules and starter files, implement its required input/output format, and test it using the supplied examples. Follow its submission instructions: accepted repositories, artifacts and hosted endpoints differ by challenge. There is no submission or automatic-payment API. Closed rounds are for studying results; planned rounds accept interest registrations. If a published deadline has passed, ask submit@builderr.ai about entry status.

## Listed challenges

### Local dictation — $500 (closed)
Build a local dictation tool that turns Hindi+English speech into text. Round 1 is complete.
- Result: https://builderr.ai/speech-to-text
- Study the completed round: https://builderr.ai/start?challenge=stt
- Standalone JSON spec unavailable; use the published result and linked scoring notes.
- Task detail (JSON): https://builderr.ai/tasks/stt.json
- Round: Closed · results published

### Kitchen CCTV monitor — $300 (deadline_passed)
Build an agent that watches kitchen video and answers questions about what happened.
- Status and details: https://builderr.ai/kitchen-video
- Published instructions (ask about late entries): https://builderr.ai/start?challenge=video
- Machine-readable spec (JSON): https://builderr.ai/api/challenge/kitchen-video
- Task detail (JSON): https://builderr.ai/tasks/kitchen-video.json
- Round: Open · hidden questions

### Trading agents — $1,000 (open)
Build a trading agent that buys and sells US stocks with paper money.
- Status and details: https://builderr.ai/trading-v0
- Build instructions: https://builderr.ai/start?challenge=trading
- Machine-readable spec (JSON): https://builderr.ai/api/challenge/trading
- Task detail (JSON): https://builderr.ai/tasks/trading.json
- Round: Open · beat the previous round winner

## For problem owners
Crowdsource AI solutions. Pay for verified outcomes.
Describe the problem and agree on what a successful solution must do. The prize is paid only when the agreed requirements are met; see the posting page for evaluation costs and terms.
- Post a challenge: https://builderr.ai/post
